messages:
incidentbot: Pager: elevated 5xx error rate on model-serving-prod (us-east-1). 30% of requests returning 5xx/timeouts. Dashboard: https://redwood-infra/alerts/3999999999 :rotating_light:

morgan (oncall): ack — joining. grabbing logs and ASAP triage. anyone on runtime team free?

devon (eng-runtime): I'm on. seeing repeated segfaults from model-runner processes on node pool gpu-g4-12. stack shows SIGSEGV in libattention.so during sequence concat / kv cache growth.

samir (sre): @morgan start mitigation plan now: (1) reduce batching & kv cache, (2) reroute a % of traffic to fallback model variant in another region, (3) drain affected nodes. I'll coordinate routing changes.

morgan (oncall): doing step 1/2. applying routing override to send 60% traffic to fallback-small in us-west-2 (latency hit expected). exec: 
```
POST /api/v1/routing/override
{ "route": "fallback-small", "percent": 60, "reason": "runtime 5xx surge" }
```

devon (eng-runtime): sharing a short log snippet — repeated pattern:
```
[2026-03-17T21:12:03Z] model-runner[pid=4242]: mem_alloc failed: oom, allocating kv_cache chunk size=134217728
[2026-03-17T21:12:03Z] model-runner[pid=4242]: SIGSEGV at 0x7f8a1b2c, backtrace: libattention.so+0x8f1f
[2026-03-17T21:12:03Z] kernel: Out-of-memory: Killed process 4242 (model-runner)
```

samir (sre): OK — that points to runaway cache growth under certain input sequences. quick mitigation: disable KV caching and reduce default max_batch_size to limit per-worker memory. Morgan can you flip: `KV_CACHE_ENABLED=false` and `MAX_BATCH=8` for the prod pool?

morgan (oncall): flipping both now. patching config via infra-api: 
```
PATCH /infra/v1/pools/model-serving-prod/config
{ "kv_cache_enabled": false, "max_batch": 8 }
```
applied and rolling restarts to affected runner replicas (12 pods).

ops_bot: Action created: INC-3999 - "prod runtime 5xx: kv-cache OOMs" assigned -> devon. ETA 30m.

devon (eng-runtime): restarting looks good. error rate dropped from 30% -> 8% in last 3m. still seeing occasional segfaults on 2 nodes that didn't fully drain. collecting core dumps and uploading to /artifacts/INC-3999.

lei (pm-cs): logging customer impact: 3 enterprise customers in EU reported timeouts/5xx between 21:11-21:18 UTC. Estimated affected requests ~12k (0.9% of total traffic), spike concentrated on long-context prompts. informing CS to send an ETA and note mitigations.

samir (sre): recommendation: schedule a canary hotpatch that adds defensive allocation checks in attention kernel and a bounded kv-cache growth policy. devon, can your team do a hotpatch canary to 10% (us-east, us-west) and watch metrics for 15m?

devon (eng-runtime): yes. building hotpatch branch `hotfix/kv-guard-3999`. canary deploy now to 10% (route) with auto-rollback on >2% regression in latency or new 5xx.

ops_bot: Canary deployed: route override created -> 10% traffic to hotfix. Watchers: devon, morgan.

morgan (oncall): starting handoff notes for next oncall at +40m: mitigations in place (routing override, kv cache disabled, batch size reduced), hotpatch canary running, core dumps collected, customers notified.

devon (eng-runtime): canary shows no segfaults in 15m window and error rate on canary cohort ~0.5%. promoting to 100% in 20m. will roll forward with zero-downtime swap.

lei (pm-cs): will issue customer update: root cause under investigation, mitigation applied, engineers on it, expected full recovery within 30-60m.

samir (sre): agreed. add followups for postmortem: (a) add kv-cache soft limit by sequence length, (b) alert for rapid per-node OOM kills, (c) improve oncall runbook for model-serving kernel faults.

ops_bot: Handoff created to night-oncall (sara) at 40m: INC-3999. README: mitigations applied + hotpatch promoted. postmortem owner: devon.

morgan (oncall): wrapping. final status before handoff: error rate stable ~0.4%, no new segfaults in 20m, affected customers notified. handing to @sara (night oncall) with details in INC-3999.

devon (eng-runtime): quick note for postmortem: repro uses long-context repeating tokens that trigger exponential kv-cache growth in rare attention fusion path. will include reproducer and unit test.

lei (pm-cs): thanks — I'll coordinate comms and follow-ups with CS.

samir (sre): closing live mitigation. handoff complete. keep INC-3999 open for postmortem artifacts. :white_check_mark:
